info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Deliverys-v4-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Delivery API enables users to retrieve information about prescriptions that are scheduled for delivery. This endpoint provides details about the status, timing, and specific prescriptions assigned for delivery to patients. It serves as a crucial interface for pharmacy staff, healthcare providers, and logistics teams ensuring efficient management of prescription deliveries. Typical use cases include tracking delivery progress and verifying delivery details for patient prescriptions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the status of prescription deliveries. It provides real-time updates on the delivery progress and estimated arrival times, ensuring that you are always informed about your prescriptions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary parameters for retrieving delivery information related to prescriptions. Ensure that all required fields in the JSON schema are supplied to successfully obtain the delivery details.

201.description: Resource created successfully for the delivery of prescriptions.
